div.p: In order to predicate the schedulability of real-time embedded system in the model design stage, a new schedulability analysis method for embedded system models using Architecture Analysis and Design Language (AADL) is presented in this paper. Through analyzing system architecture, component properties and component connections, we build the Resource Competition Model (RCM) for the AADL model. Based on the RCM, the respond time of thread components can be calculated, and we get the schedulability of system AADL model. This approach is on the model level to analyze the schedulability of systems without code implement. It has higher calculation efficiency, and a lower requirement for the system description. At last, a case-study is carried out to show the schedulability analysis process for an AADL model.

div.head: I. INTRODUCTION
div.p: With the rapid development of the embedded system, the embedded system becomes more complex in structure and larger in scale. Meanwhile, the demands of development cost, development cycle and non-functional attributes (such as schedulability, security and reliability) become higher. Therefore, the Model Driven Architecture (MDA) development method is introduced into both industry and academic. The coding on specific computing platform can be automatically completed with assistant tools, so the modeling becomes the central work in the system development process. During the MDA development process of an embedded system, it's necessary to analyze the nonfunctional attributes of the system at design stage, and it could support design modification and optimization for the system model, which greatly shorten the system development cycle and save the development cost.

In order to achieve the MDA development method for embedded systems, AADL is proposed by the Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) [1]. AADL provides the capability to describe the software and hardware architecture for the embedded system through describing component properties, connections, and component calls which implement the component communication [2]. In addition, SAE proposes the Behavior Annex as the extension of AADL core language [3]. It can describe behavior details of components especially threads and subprograms, which strengthen the component actual function behavior description capability of AADL. Some researchers have applied the model-driven analysis technique based on AADL to reliability analysis [4]. Nevertheless, compared to the schedulability analysis methods based on code, the schedulability analysis based on AADL architecture model and AADL behavior model still has many difficulties. On the one hand, AADL model doesn't care the implementation of components. It just describes components, component properties, component connections and bindings, so the schedulability analysis can only base on the model description; On the other hand, the schedulability is a nonfunctional attribute on the system level, so it's necessary to analyze component connections to get the component interaction relation.

The schedulability analysis mainly concerns the worstcase execution time (WCET) [5]. Traditionally, system-level schedulability analysis has been done manually which is error prone and tedious. Nowadays, the main model-based schedulability analysis methods for embedded systems is scheduling simulation, the tools using this method firstly model the system by automata, and then perform the scheduling simulation to analyze the schedulability of the system.

The LISyC laboratory of Université de Bretagne Occidentale and Ellidiss Technologies developed a tool named Cheddar, which uses scheduling simulation method to model the tasks and schedulers using timed automaton, and performs simulation to get the schedulability of the system [6]. The language and tool named Real-Time Maude which developed by the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign supports the formal description, simulation and analysis for real-time system, so it can also model the system and perform scheduling simulation [7].

However, the scheduling simulation method requires very high accuracy for the description of the system model. Moreover, due to the complexity of systems, the states of the automaton may lead to excessive, which may result in unacceptable calculation time and reduce the availability of tools. So for some too complicated systems, this method is not applicable.

The tool ASIIST developed by the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign models the system by AADL and uses systematic approaches to generate equations to calculate the transmission delay time of data flows [8]. The calculation method can solve the problems of scheduling simulation method. By comparison, for the static calculation method, the accuracy required for the description of system models is relatively low and calculation efficiency is higher, which can maintain the calculation in a controllable range and improve the practicability of the tool. So this paper proposes a new method to calculate the respond time and WCET of thread components of the system modeled by AADL and get the schedulability analysis result. Firstly, we take the AADL model of the system as input and extract the component properties, interaction relations as well as the component executing orders. Secondly, build the RCM for the system. Finally, we calculate the respond time of thread components and get the schedulability analysis result for the system.

The rest of the paper is organized as follows: Section 2 introduces the schedulability analysis method based on AADL model. Section 3 gives an overview of the approach to build the RCM for an embedded system and the process of calculating the respond time of a thread component. Section 4 describes a case study to show the new approach. Section 5 provides conclusion and further work.

div.head: II. SCHEDULABILITY ANALYSIS METHOD
div.p: The WCET of a thread comprises two parts: the respond time and the executing time. The execution time of a thread can be directly obtained from the thread property in the architecture model. The respond time of a thread is determined by the competition relationships among threads for the processor resources and the execution time of threads. In terms of the threads bound on the same processor, they either compete for the processor resource or execute in the synchronous order. Before calculating the respond time, we need analyze the thread relationships as the basis of building the RCM of the system. The AADL model of a system determine the execution dependency relationship of components in the system, and a resource competition model (RCM) can be constructed through analyzing the interaction relationship to determine the executing order of thread components. The schedulability analysis method presented in this paper is based on RCM to calculate the respond time for each thread and get the schedulability analysis result of the system. The process can be divided into four steps, shown in Fig. 1: Step1: According to the requirement of system modeling, design the AADL model;

Step2: Through the analysis of the AADL model, extract the component time-related properties and component interaction relationships to get the component competition relationships for the processor resource, and then build the RCM with interference sets for the system;
Step3: Caculate the respond time of each thread;
Step4: Compare the sum of respond time and executing time of a thread with its deadline property to get the schedulability of the thread.

And then it can check every thread in the AADL model according to above process to get the system schedulability analysis result. If the schedulability doesn't meet the system requirement, the system model designers need to go back to Step1 to modify or redesign the AADL model for the system until the schedulability meets the system requirement.

div.head: V. CONCLUSION AND FURTHER WORK
div.p: To analyze the schedulability of an embedded system based on AADL model, this paper presents a new approach to build the RCM of the system. According to the RCM, we can calculate the respond time of thread components and complete the schedulability analysis for the system. The static calculation method presented in this paper needs lower accuracy for the description of system models and has higher calculation efficiency, so it can improve the practicability of the tool. In subsequent research, we need in-depth study the component interaction relationships in the model and improve the algorithm of building the concurrent body sets for processes and the interference sets for threads, then increase the accuracy of calculating the response time of threads. Moreover, we plan to consider analyzing the schedulability of an embedded system with Multi-processor architecture.
